description: Vodafone Idea (Vi) has launched the Rs. 35 Vi prepaid recharge plan. It is available as an add-on pack and does not replace the user's existing service-validity recharge. It offers access to two regional OTT platforms of the customer's choice for 28 days. Customers can choose from SonyLIV, Chaupal, ManoramaMax, KLiKK, AddaTimes, and Aao NXT.  The pack is available only to customers who have an active Vi prepaid service-validity recharge. Subscribers can stream content through the Vi Movies and TV app on their smartphones.
title: Vodafone Idea (Vi) Rs. 35 Prepaid Plan Launched With Access to Two Regional OTT Platforms, 1GB Data

description: Motorola's upcoming foldable smartphone could be named the Motorola Razr Flex 2027. The tipster shared a screenshot that appears to have been taken from the company's official website with this name. It is tipped to come with a 6.92-inch internal OLED folding display with a 165Hz refresh rate. The device is also said to sport a 4.97-inch cover display and is likely to be powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 processor.
title: Name of Motorola's Upcoming Wide Foldable Phone Revealed in New Leak

description: Razer Hammerhead V3 Chroma wired gaming earphones have been launched with active noise cancellation (ANC), USB Type-C connectivity, and customisable Chroma RGB lighting. The earphones feature 11mm dynamic drivers paired with 6mm tweeters. The earbuds also support THX Surround Sound 7.1 on PC. They have an IPX4 water-resistance rating.
title: Razer Hammerhead V3 Chroma Wired Earphones Launched With ANC, IPX4 Rating: Price, Features

description: Vivo V80 FE has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number V2624. The handset was earlier spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) database with the same model number, hinting at an imminent launch in the country. The Geekbench listing suggests that the Indian version of the Vivo V80 FE will be powered by the MediaTek MT6878 chipset, which is the octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7400-Turbo SoC. It appears to have four efficiency cores clocked at 2.0GHz and four performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of up to 2.6GHz. The Vivo V80 FE has been spotted with 7.31GB of RAM, which could be marketed as 8GB of RAM. Further, the handset is listed with Android 17. It managed to score 911 points on Geekbench’s single-core performance test and 3,041 points on the multi-core performance test.
title: Vivo V80 FE India Variant Appears on Geekbench With MediaTek Dimensity 7400-Turbo SoC Ahead of Launch

description: Sony has announced the sales of Marvel's Wolverine. Insomniac Games' action-adventure title has sold 2.4 million units in its first 50 days after launch. The game launched to mixed reviews in September. The PlayStation parent also said it expected to make "solid progress" on the PS6 in the next fiscal year.
title: Marvel's Wolverine Sells 2.4 Million Copies, Sony Says It Will Make 'Solid Progress' on PS6 Next Year

description: iQOO is said to be working on another smartphone in its Z-series lineup. According to a tipster, the purported handset could feature a 7-inch screen and a battery with a capacity exceeding 10,000mAh. It is said to have entered the mould stage. This suggests that its overall dimensions and design have largely been finalised. While its final name remains unclear, the tipster claims that it could be part of the upcoming iQOO Z12 series.
title: iQOO's Next Z-Series Phone Could Pack a 7-Inch Screen, 10,000mAh Battery, Tipster Claims

description: Airbnb is currently developing a dedicated AI agent for travel plans, the company revealed in the shareholder letter for Q3 2026. The company plans to launch the dedicated AI-powered tool for travel plans in the first half of 2027. The platform claims that the AI travel agent will help users plan and book trips. Airbnb highlighted that it has three advantages over other firms in building an AI agent that will allow users to plan their travels. It says that its 20 years of experience came in handy while designing the AI agent that will offer a “personalised travel search and booking experience”. The company claims that other AI agents will find this aspect hard to replicate. Further, it says that it is at an advantage because Airbnb is part of the ecosystem that enables “reservations, payments, and customer support”. Hence, Airbnb’s new AI agent will be capable of helping guests at different stages of their travels.
title: Airbnb Developing a Dedicated AI Agent for Travel Plans; Will Launch Next Year

description: OnePlus 16 could be launched in India soon as the company has reportedly started discussing the phone's possible debut in the country. Recently, a report highlighted that the OnePlus 16 will not be launched in India. The decision was reportedly made as part of a revamped product strategy of the tech firm. Instead of the OnePlus 16, the rumoured OnePlus 16R was said to lead the company’s product lineup in the country in 2026-2027. However, the company has neither confirmed details about its changed strategy nor about the OnePlus 16 India launch.
title: OnePlus 16 India Launch Seems Likely as Firm Reportedly Holds ‘Closed-Door’ Meeting; Pricing Details Tipped

description: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Cyber on Thursday as its latest AI model to help security researchers identify software vulnerabilities, develop working exploits, and create fixes. According to the San Francisco-based company, it delivers significant improvements over GPT-5.6 Cyber on cybersecurity benchmarks, including a 51 percent relative improvement on ExploitGym. The AI model is also claimed to be capable of following authorised testing boundaries more reliably. OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber has already helped uncover vulnerabilities in widely used software.
title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-6 Cyber With Improved Vulnerability Detection and Exploit Development

description: ElevenMusic, the AI music generation platform from ElevenLabs, and SoundCloud announced a partnership. With this, ElevenMusic is enabling creators to publish their music directly beyond its own platform through a new integration with SoundCloud. The new integration allows creators to experiment and produce music in ElevenMusic, then publish directly to SoundCloud without interrupting their creative workflow.
title: ElevenLabs Partners With SoundCloud to Let Users Publish AI-Generated Music Directly

description: WhatsApp has announced multiple updates for the Event feature. The company said that the new features will be rolled out to all users in the coming weeks. Among the new features, the company has added the ability to share WhatsApp event links with users who do not have a WhatsApp account, such as the WhatsApp Guest Call functionality. Users can now create an event, add a cover photo, and share the link directly with others. The RSVP status, whether the invited person will be attending the event or not, will be shown to the user who created the event. The invited members do not have to download the app or create a WhatsApp account to RSVP to the event.
title: WhatsApp Adds Events Home Hub and Guest RSVPs for Users Without Accounts

description: Apple has released a new Shot on iPhone film for Diwali, titled ‘Step into the Light’, in collaboration with Indian fashion brand Raw Mango. Directed by Raw Mango founder Sanjay Garg, Apple claims the film was shot entirely on the iPhone 18 Pro at Tijara Fort, a restored 19th-century royal palace in Rajasthan. It features performers from different parts of India. Apple has also highlighted the iPhone 18 Pro's camera capabilities, particularly its low-light performance, as part of the campaign.
title: Apple Celebrates Diwali With New Shot on iPhone 18 Pro Film Directed by Raw Mango

description: YouTube has announced a big new change to its app on iOS and Android. Users opening their respective apps may be a bit surprised to see the usual Subscriptions tab disappear. YouTube has replaced the popular Subscriptions tab with a new Home Page, which requires some adjustment as it's not always visible after launch.
title: YouTube Replaces Subscriptions Tab With New Home Page in Major App Interface Redesign

description: Claude Personal Finance has been launched by Anthropic as the AI giant's new financial management tool. The financial management tool will start rolling out later this week and will be available to Pro, Max, and Ultra subscribers in the US, the company said. On top of this, Anthropic assures that, “like the rest of Claude”, Personal Finance will not present any ads or sponsored recommendations, such as credit cards, loans, or savings accounts of “its own”. The company says that the Claude Personal Finance tool will be able to create spending charts, calendars of scheduled payments, and a dashboard including the figures a user chooses to see. After the AI tool has generated the chart, users can choose to make adjustments based on their preferences. Users can ask the chatbot to generate a spending chart and place each transaction in a category.
title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Personal Finance as an Integrated AI Financial Management Tool

description: Google DeepMind has introduced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, its latest video generation model. With this model, Google says users can draft content at 360p or 720p for $0.07 per second, with the flexibility to upscale final outputs to 1080p or 4K. It supports generating and editing continuous video clips up to 15 seconds long.  Developers can access the model through the Gemini API and start using Google AI Studio. Enterprise customers can access it through Google Cloud.
title: Google Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash Launched With Support for Clips Up to 15 Seconds Long

description: Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has filed a criminal complaint against BG Limited, the operator of cryptocurrency exchange Bitget, for allegedly providing digital asset services without a licence. The regulator has referred the case to the Economic Crime Suppression Division and instructed the Ministry of Digital Economy and Society to block the exchange's website and mobile application from December 5. Authorities have asked customers to take necessary measures before the deadline. The investigation covers Bitget's activities in Thailand between 2022 and 2025.
title: Bitget to Be Blocked in Thailand From December 5, Over Unlicensed Cryptocurrency Trading

description: Oppo Reno 17 will feature a glowing cat-like design element on the back, as the company has started teasing the design of the handset. The upcoming smartphone is shown to feature a flat rear panel, with a square-shaped camera module in the top-left corner. The Reno branding appears inside the camera island, along with a triple camera system and an LED flash. The same glowing cat figure appears in other marketing material on the company’s Weibo page. However, the tech firm has not specified whether the design element will be featured on both the Oppo Reno 17 and the Oppo Reno 17 Pro. The handset is shown in a white colourway. It will also sport a flat metal mid-frame, finished in a silver shade. The power button and volume controls will be placed on the right side of the handset.
title: Oppo Reno 17 Teaser Reveals Familiar Design With the Addition of a Glowing Cat Element

description: Sony has introduced a new pair of wired headphones that brings back the design of one of its most recognisable audio products. According to the company, the MDR-3R takes inspiration from the original MDR-3 headphones, which debuted in 1979 alongside the company's first Walkman. The new model retains the lightweight, open-ear design and several visual details of its predecessor, while swapping the traditional 3.5mm audio connector for a USB Type-C port. The headphones also feature 23mm drivers, an in-line remote, and a built-in microphone.
title: Sony MDR-3R Headphones Launched With USB-C Connectivity, Retro Walkman Design

description: Caviar has introduced a new bespoke collection for the foldable iPhone Duo. Known as the Zodiac collection, it is designed around all 12 astrological signs, with each model featuring a corresponding zodiac-inspired design. Buyers can choose from a wide range of materials and decorative finishes, including gold, silver, titanium, precious stones, leather, and meteorite.
title: iPhone Duo Gets 12 Zodiac-Inspired Custom Designs From Luxury Brand Caviar

description: After launching Muse in the US in September, Meta has now released a bigger update that will let users have real-time conversations with its AI assistant. Muse Voice will work with Muse Realtime Avatar technology and let users watch their AI assistant react and interact with facial expressions.
title: Meta Launches Muse Voice Letting Users Have Real-Time Conversations With the AI Assistant

description: The iQOO 16 was launched in China last month, and the company is preparing to bring it to other markets. Meanwhile, a new report suggests that the company’s flagship lineup could be expanded with another model. The purported handset, dubbed the iQOO 16s was recently spotted on a certification website, which hints at its launch. It will reportedly be powered by a flagship chipset from Qualcomm and pack a 10,000mAh battery.
title: iQOO 16s Reportedly Spotted on Malaysia’s SIRIM Certification Site, May Pack 10,000mAh Battery

description: Bitcoin erased its post-election gains on Friday as a sharp sell-off in global technology and AI stocks weighed on cryptocurrency markets. The decline triggered $1.08 billion in liquidations over 24 hours, mostly involving leveraged bullish positions. Investors are also monitoring US employment data, Federal Reserve rate expectations, and institutional ETF flows for signs of further market direction.
title: Bitcoin Falls Below $76,000 as Global Equity Sell-Off Triggers $1.08 Billion in Crypto Liquidations

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 could be launched in India soon, as the smartphone has been spotted in the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) database, according to a report. The phone is reportedly listed with the model number SM-S952B/DS, which reportedly belongs to one of the variants of the rumoured Samsung Galaxy S27. The listing suggests that the handset could be launched in India soon. However, the South Korean tech giant has yet to confirm these details. It is worth noting that the anticipated launch of the handset is still months away. According to previous reports, the Samsung Galaxy S27 series is expected to be launched in India and other global markets in January or February 2027. It is expected to arrive with the other three rumoured Samsung Galaxy S27 series handsets.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 India Launch Seemingly Confirmed as Phone Appears on Certification Database: Report

description: Oppo Find X10 Ultra and vivo X500 Ultra could launch soon. While earlier leaks had hinted at substantial improvements to the camera hardware on both devices, a new leak has now offered more details about their expected camera configurations. The Find X10 Ultra is said to feature a quad rear camera unit including three 200-megapixel cameras and a dedicated 50-megapixel 10x periscope telephoto sensor. Vivo X500 Ultra could arrive with a 200-megapixel primary camera and a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto shooter.
title: Oppo Find X10 Ultra, Vivo X500 Ultra Camera Specifications Leaked; Hints at Multiple 200-Megapixel Sensors

description: Motorola has launched two new wearable devices alongside its Motorola Signature 27 flagship. The first device is the Moto Watch 2 Fit which runs RTOS operating system and will reportedly last 7 days on full charge. The second, is the Moto Buds 2 Ultra which the brand claims is its most feature-packed TWS earphones yet.
title: Moto Watch 2 Fit Watch and Buds 2 Ultra TWS Earphones Announced With Polar Tracking and Sound by Bose

description: Instagram has launched a desktop version of its video creation app, Edits, for macOS. According to the Meta-owned platform, the Edits app for Mac brings a more comprehensive editing workspace to Mac users, with a multi-track timeline, keyframe controls, colour grading tools, and support for custom fonts and audio. It also allows creators to export videos in resolutions of up to 4K without watermarks and publish them directly to Instagram. The desktop launch comes as Edits crosses 50 million users, just over a year after its debut on mobile devices, according to the company.
title: Instagram Launches Edits for Mac With Multi-Track Video Editing, 4K Exports

description: Apple is said to be tightening its spending limits on artificial intelligence (AI) tools used by employees. According to a report, the Cupertino-based tech giant has already reduced the daily allowance for some engineers using AI models from $300 to $200, with further cuts being considered for select teams, even as it looks to make AI a bigger part of its internal operations. The proposed changes will reportedly bring some engineering budgets down to $100 per day. Meanwhile, employees in other departments may also face lower limits.
title: Apple Reportedly Lowers AI Spending Limits for Engineers Amid Cost-Cutting Push

description: Apple's new Retention Messages feature gives app developers a chance to reach users before they cancel an auto-renewable subscription. Messages can include details about subscription benefits or special offers, such as a reduced price for continuing. Developers can manage these prompts through App Store Connect, choose which subscribers are eligible to see them and control the time between messages. Apple has also introduced a Retention Messaging API, which gives developers more flexibility in choosing messages based on individual subscription details.
title: Apple App Store Gets New Feature to Encourage Users to Keep Subscriptions

description: JBL Professional 3 Series MkIII powered studio monitors and the 310S MkIII powered subwoofer have been launched. The new lineup includes the JBL 305P MkIII, 306P MkIII and 308P MkIII studio monitors. The JBL 305P MkIII is a 5-inch two-way studio monitor. It offers a low-frequency extension of 45Hz. The JBL 306P MkIII has a 6.5-inch two-way configuration. It delivers a low-frequency extension of 43Hz. The JBL 308P MkIII comes with an 8-inch two-way configuration.
title: JBL 3 Series MkIII Studio Monitors Launched Alongside 310S MkIII Subwoofer: Specifications

description: Lumio's TLDR platform now includes Flix, a new section that brings curated YouTube Shorts about films, television shows and music into its content discovery experience. The feed includes trailers, clips and reviews, with an option to find the app where a featured title is available. TLDR was first introduced with Lumio's Vision smart TVs and later expanded to its Arc projectors. The platform is also available on the web and comes preloaded on supported Lumio devices.
title: Lumio Adds YouTube Shorts Feed to TLDR With New Flix Feature

description: Dhanteras is considered an auspicious occasion to purchase gold, with many people buying the precious metal as a symbol of prosperity and good fortune. However, visiting jewellery stores can mean dealing with crowds, limited time to compare options, and the need to arrange for safe storage. Digital gold offers an online alternative. It allows users to buy gold in small amounts through apps on their smartphones. Several payment and fintech platforms offer this option, with some letting users start with as little as Re. 1.
title: Want to Buy Digital Gold This Dhanteras? Here Are 5 Apps to Try

description: Hackers reportedly targeted Android and iOS users through compromised websites. According to a report by cybersecurity firm Sekoia TDR, the attackers exploited a Google Chrome vulnerability and a flaw in Qualcomm's Adreno GPU driver to compromise Android devices. The campaign reportedly targeted Chrome versions 139 to 145. Sekoia attributed the campaign to the Russian state-sponsored hacking group APT29.
title: Hackers Exploited Chrome and Qualcomm Vulnerabilities to Target Android Devices: Report
